sourceOfTruth: A draft reply to a Microsoft Store review (5 stars, Brazil, 2026-11-14, v1.37.0.0). Not an app string and not listing copy: the slice borrows the app-string shape so the verifier can read the pair. The reply is not sent until the owner approves the wording.

fields.en: Thanks for telling us! That's exactly the idea: you save each account once and open several at the same time, each in its own window. If something goes wrong or something is missing, write to support@626labs.dev. We read everything.

translations.pt-br: Valeu por contar! A ideia é essa mesma: você salva cada conta uma vez e abre várias ao mesmo tempo, cada uma na sua janela. Se algo der errado ou se faltar alguma coisa, escreva para support@626labs.dev. A gente lê tudo.
